_comment: Advisories the NPM Security Audit gate waives (scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs). Each entry needs a reason and a review_by date; an expired entry fails the gate again. Keep this list to advisories with no usable fix.

advisories.reason: Fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1 (advisory published 2026-10-30, no 3.x/9.x/10.x backport; checked 2026-11-04). It enters only through lint tooling (eslint 9, @eslint/eslintrc, eslint-plugin-import need minimatch 3.x; @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree needs 10.x), and 11.x drops the default export those call. Dev-only: globs come from first-party lint config, never from untrusted input, and nothing ships to the browser.
